title: LGBTQ+ Support
subtitle:
Mutual aid networks and initiatives focused on supporting LGBTQ+ communities through
                    solidarity, direct support, and community organizing.

initiatives.name: Transgender, Gender-Variant & Intersex Justice Project (TGIJP)
initiatives.description: A San Francisco nonprofit led by Black trans people that supports transgender, gender-variant and intersex people inside and coming out of prison, with re-entry, housing and legal advocacy programs.

initiatives.name: Trans Asylum Seeker Support Network
initiatives.description: A national mutual aid collective building an autonomous organization to provide very longterm, comprehensive, and needs-based support to trans women and LGBTQI+ people that is not available through nonprofits, churches, or sponsorships.

initiatives.name: Trans Doe Task Force
initiatives.description: A trans-led nonprofit organization that finds and researches cases of LGBTQ+ missing and murdered persons.

initiatives.name: Point of Pride
initiatives.description: Nonprofit that funds gender-affirming care for trans people, including surgery grants, 18 months of free HRT care, hair removal, small grants, and free binders.

initiatives.name: 360 Health X
initiatives.description: Nonprofit led by trans people of color offering gender-affirming health services, support groups, fitness, insurance navigation and free binders and clothing in VA, DC, MD and NY, plus virtual services.

initiatives.name: Gender Liberation Movement
initiatives.description: Building a movement for bodily autonomy, self-determination, collectivism, & fulfillment. It’s our bodies, our genders, our choices, our futures!

initiatives.name:
ACLU LGBTQ
                            Rights Legislative Tracker
initiatives.description: A comprehensive resource tracking anti-LGBTQ legislation across U.S. state legislatures, maintained by the ACLU's legal and advocacy team. The tracker monitors bills targeting transgender rights, local protections, and religious exemptions while providing updates on the status of legislation and related court cases. This tool helps communities stay informed about legislative threats and organize mutual aid responses to support affected LGBTQ+ individuals.

initiatives.name: LGBTQ Freedom Fund
initiatives.description: Pays immigration bond for LGBTQ people in ICE detention in every US state, and pretrial bail for LGBTQ people in Florida jails.

initiatives.name: National Center for LGBTQ Rights (NCLR)
initiatives.description: Legal organization that brings impact litigation and does policy work and education on LGBTQ civil rights, including youth, family, immigration, and discrimination cases. Works across the US.

initiatives.name: Queer Liberation Library
initiatives.description: Online library of LGBTQ+ books and resources, with digital collections and memberships. Fiscally sponsored by a Massachusetts nonprofit and serves people across the US.

initiatives.name: LGBTQ+ Mutual Aid Network
initiatives.description: An online community fostering mutual aid and solidarity through direct support and resource sharing for LGBTQ+ individuals. They coordinate assistance requests, community support, and solidarity networks while building power through digital organizing, peer support, and creating virtual spaces for LGBTQ+ mutual aid.

initiatives.name: Intersex Justice Project
initiatives.description: Intersex Justice Project works to end invasive and unnecessary surgeries on intersex youth by empowering intersex people of color as change-makers.

initiatives.name: Counter Narrative Project (CNP)
initiatives.description: Atlanta-based nonprofit that works to change how the media portrays Black gay, bisexual, and queer men. Runs The Reckoning publication, a podcast network, media grants, and a leadership institute.
